about: Black Ops zone files the launcher reads from the player's install. load = referenced while linking (techniques, sounds, animations stay theirs); unlink = dumped to read weapon files, models, materials and scripts; both = dumped and referenced. Zones are processed in order; each dump loads the zones listed before it.

columns.dir: folder under the Black Ops zone folder
columns.tested_in_game: true once seen working on a real install

rows.about: shared Zombies assets: the zombie weapon files, view models and materials most maps share
Kino: its own weapons, models, materials and scripts; also referenced while linking
